items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1962-11-01
items.q: So he told Joey, he said, I'd like to get your band to play for me at the Moulin Rouge. ... So, well, what we did, we started playing for him.

ctx.x: Yeah. So, all right. So, well, all right. So, well, after that, after Speck had got this dance all completed, he wanted us to play at the Moulin Rouge for him, you see? We opened the Moulin Rouge. So he told Joey, he said, I'd like to get your band to play for me at the Moulin Rouge.
I said, Joey, sure? Yeah, sure.
